citations.title: Coinbase brings 170+ derivatives contracts to UK professional investors, with perpetuals offering up to 50x leverage
UK regulator drafts tokenised gold framework to bolster London’s role in global bullion trading
Robinhood secures UK crypto registration under FCA’s AML regime ahead of 2027 overhaul

summary: The UK is moving crypto into a purpose-built financial-services regime. Its prospects now turn on authorisation, stablecoin economics, banking access, enforcement and whether tokenisation can strengthen London’s established markets.
